name: ansible-module-assist
description: Dot-triggered IntelliSense for Ansible playbooks: ansible.builtin, ansible.posix and every installed Galaxy collection (pfsensible.core, community.general, ...), with module options, choices and docs on hover.

ansibleModules.ansibleBinPath.markdownDescription: Folder containing `ansible`, `ansible-galaxy` and `ansible-doc` (e.g. a virtualenv `bin` folder). Leave empty to use PATH, `~/.local/bin` and `.venv/bin` in the workspace.

ansibleModules.collectionsPaths.markdownDescription: Extra collection paths to scan, in addition to `ansible-galaxy collection list`, `ansible.cfg`, `ANSIBLE_COLLECTIONS_PATH`, `~/.ansible/collections` and `./collections`.

ansibleModules.useAnsibleDoc.markdownDescription: Fall back to `ansible-doc` when a module's documentation can't be read from its source file (rare). Docs are read from the module files first because that's instant.

ansibleModules.insertRequiredOptions.description: When a module is picked, insert its required options as a snippet.

ansibleModules.inlineSuggestions.markdownDescription: Show module parameters as grey inline ghost text (like inline AI suggestions): the next required parameter on a new line, partial parameter names, and default/choice values. Press `Tab` to accept.

ansibleModules.suggestShortNames.markdownDescription: Typing a bare module name (e.g. `copy`) offers the full name (`ansible.builtin.copy`).

ansibleModules.suggestTaskKeywords.markdownDescription: Also suggest task keywords such as `name`, `when`, `register`, `loop`, `become`.

enumDescriptions: Only in YAML files that look like Ansible (tasks/, roles/, playbooks, files with hosts:/tasks:/- name:)

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
